duration.text: The One Year Chinese Language at Shandong Vocational and Technical University of International Studies is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1388 USD/per year ￥ 10000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application form 2. Scanned copy of passport 3.5 two inch, white-background identification photos 4. Scanned copy of final education or student certificate 5. Scanned copy of transcript (or certificate of employment for employees) 6. Certificate of no criminal record 7. Medical certificate

requirements.text: Applicant: Foreigners who want to learn Chinese and Chinese culture. Admission Requirements: The applicant should be between 18 and 35, be in good health and have a high school graduation certificate.
